annotations.title: Get the booking link for a session

description: Get the link that books one place in a session found with search_sessions or search_nearby_sessions. Give the link to the person: they open it, confirm, and finish on the enrolment site, where they enter their own details and pay themselves. This tool books nothing, holds no seat and takes no personal or payment details, so don't tell the person they are booked. The link is for one person: for a group, book each person separately or use the corporate enquiry page (/corporate).

session_id.description: The session_id from a search_sessions or search_nearby_sessions result.

name: start_booking

booking_url.description: The page the person opens to book one place in the session.
